## What changed

- **Fixes a `0.12.3-fork.14` that could not be installed at all.** Every route
  — mise, npm, and the release tarball — failed with
  `404 Not Found @lat.md/server`. If you are on `fork.14`, this release is the
  upgrade; nothing else changed in the CLI.
- **The UI's Express runtime now ships inside the package.** It used to be
  listed as a dependency on a package that has never been published to npm.
- **CI and the release workflow now install the packed tarball and run it.**
  A broken package fails the build instead of reaching npm. Both the build and
  the full test suite passed on `fork.14`, because both ran against the source
  tree, where the missing dependency resolves locally.

## Upgrading

```
mise use -g npm:@plebeiantech/lat.md@latest
```

```
npm i -g --prefix ~/.local/lat https://github.com/PlebeianTech/lat.md/releases/latest/download/lat.md-latest.tgz
```
